The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 37e6d650c989c3fb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 22. statement: Fix a positive dimension. Consider a sequence of smooth projective varieties F over algebraically closed fields isomorphic to C, with projective birational morphisms F → F0 to normal varieties. Let ηF be an lc rational volume form, and let L be the pullback of a big semiample effective Q-Cartier divisor on F0. Suppose the supports of div(ηF ) and L on F have simple normal crossings. Write lw = w(L) and assume the following conditions. (i) For every divisorial valuation w, the equality AηF (w) = 0 implies lw > 0. (ii) For every prime divisor P on F0, AηF (P) = 1 if lP = 0, AηF (P) ≤ ϵlP if lP > 0, where ϵ → 0 along the sequence. (iii) For every rational 0 < b ≤ 1/10, h0(F, KF + ⌈bL⌉) = 1. (iv) There is a uniform constant C such that every effective Q-divisor J ∼Q L satisfies w(J) ≤ Clw at every divisorial valuation with AηF (w) = 0. Then, after passage to a subsequence, there is a uniform constant C′ such that every such J and every divisorial valuation w satisfy (5.2) w(J) ≤ C′ ( AηF (w) + lw ) . It suffices that the hypotheses hold sufficiently far along the sequence.
